title: 6 Entryway Styles in One Entryway, Vintage to Boho
description: One entryway shown in six styles: Vintage, Farmhouse, Modern, Japandi, Coastal and Boho, plus four no-drill picks to try the look.
dek: Same door, window, walls and floor. Only the furniture, mirror, rug and small decor change. Browse six styles, then pick the swaps that fit.
hook: It is hard to picture an entryway style until you see it in a space like yours. This guide shows one entryway with the same white six-panel door, window, warm white walls and plank floor in six styles, so the furniture, mirror, rug and decor are the only things that change.

The images are AI-generated concept pictures, not photos of a real entryway, and the furniture shown is a style idea rather than a specific product. The picks below are small swaps that work in a rental, so you can move toward a look without buying a console or bench.
gallery_intro: Each look changes only the furniture, mirror, rug and small decor. The door, window, walls and floor stay the same.
gallery_note: AI-generated concept images of one entryway. They show the idea of each style, not photos of a real entryway or of the exact items in the picks below.

how_note: Prices are brackets because prices change, so check the listing. Product images on this page are illustrations.

picks.name: pickpiff 13LB Strong Stick-on Hooks for Coat & Towel, Black 4 Pack
picks.alt: Illustration of four black adhesive wall hooks
picks.best_for: A coat and bag hook row in the Farmhouse and Modern looks
picks.limit: Wait 24 hours before use and skip rough or chalky walls
picks.why: Four black double hooks with an adhesive back and no drilling, listed to hold up to 13 lb each. A hook row is what turns an entry wall into a drop zone without touching the paint.
picks.con: The listing says to let the adhesive set for 24 hours and to avoid rough or chalky surfaces, and reviewers are mixed on how well it stays up, so test it with a light bag first.

picks.name: Command Variety Pack, 10 Pairs of Picture Hanging Strips, 6 Wire Hooks and 8 Utility Hooks
picks.alt: Illustration of a Command strip and hook variety kit
picks.best_for: Hanging a light mirror or frames in any of the six looks
picks.limit: Wait 7 days after painting and not for wallpaper
picks.why: A kit of picture strips, wire hooks and utility hooks that mount without nails. It is the starter set for hanging a light frame or hooks in a rental entry.
picks.con: The listing says to wait seven days after painting before use, to clean the surface first, and not to use it on wallpaper. Check the weight rating on the strips against what you hang.

picks.name: GUSHBIN 7.4 Inch Key Bowl for Entryway Table, Gold Decorative Bowl
picks.alt: Illustration of a gold decorative key bowl
picks.best_for: The small bowl that finishes a Vintage or Coastal console
picks.limit: It is 7.4 inches wide, so measure your surface
picks.why: A 7.4 by 7.4 by 2.6 inch stainless steel bowl with a gold finish. Keys and small items land in one spot, and the metal adds the warm accent that the Vintage look leans on.
picks.con: It is a small catchall, so it holds keys and little items, not mail. The finish is listed as gold, so check the listing photo against the tone you want.

picks.name: Hipiwe Set of 2 Flat Wicker Storage Baskets with Lid, Seagrass
picks.alt: Illustration of two flat seagrass baskets with lids
picks.best_for: Woven texture and hidden storage for the Japandi, Coastal and Boho looks
picks.why: Two flat lidded seagrass baskets, the smaller listed at 11 by 9.25 by 2.5 inches, that stack inside each other. They hide gloves, chargers and small items on a shelf or bench.
picks.con: Seagrass varies in shade, so your set may not match the picture, and the baskets are flat, so they will not hold shoes or bulky items.

final: If you buy one, make it the hooks. A row of hooks does the most to make a small entry work every day, and it comes off a rental wall. Add the key bowl to keep the small things in one place.
skipped: Consoles, benches, mirrors and rugs, since the images show style ideas, not products.
Anything that needs drilling or wiring.
A mirror cabinet that hangs over a door, which does not fit an open entry wall.
